messages:
clara: Quick note from today's mixed-int4 onboarding run. Key takeaways: perf ups, a couple of fidelity hotspots on multi-turn code edits.

diego: Can you drop the per-slice diffs? especially code-assist and math QA.

clara: Short table: code-assist MRR -1.7pp, halluc +0.5pp; math-qa MRR -0.3pp, halluc +0.2pp; conv median latency -30ms, p95 -80ms. No OOMs.

han: Sounds like we should gate code-assist tighter. Proposal: 2% -> 8% -> 40% -> 100% with an embedded fidelity probe for structured outputs.

clara: Agreed. Also add routing override: sessions > 4096 tokens go to nf4. And keep 10% shadow to nf4 for rolling comparisons.

ops-bot: Draft rollout saved. Please approve to schedule canary.

lucy: For user-facing search, set halluc_delta threshold to 0.002 (hold after 10m sustained). For internal flows, 0.004 OK.

diego: Add smoke eval every 3 minutes that runs a deterministic promptset and fails canary on exact-match drop > 1%. Also export failing sessions to s3 for triage.

clara: Draft canary config below; I'll wire to Console and request approvals.

```json
{
  "variant": "mixed-int4",
  "steps": [2, 8, 40, 100],
  "shadow": {"pct": 10, "baseline": "nf4-stable"},
  "fidelity_probe": {"promptset": "rwd_structured_v1", "interval_secs": 180, "exact_match_threshold": 0.99},
  "signals": [
    {"slice": "code-assist", "metric": "mrr", "delta_pp": -0.01, "window_mins": 10, "action": "hold"},
    {"metric": "halluc_rate", "delta_pp": 0.002, "window_mins": 10, "action": "hold"}
  ],
  "auto_fallback": {"mins": 20, "route_to": "nf4-stable"},
  "routing_overrides": [{"cond": "session_length_tokens > 4096", "route_to": "nf4-stable"}],
  "failure_export": "s3://rw-inference/canary-failures/mixed-int4/"
}
```

ops-bot: Canary job queued awaiting eng-ml lead approval. :gear:
